name: typical
query: A read-only review finds that a new document endpoint verifies login but never checks document ownership. Anonymous access is denied.
expected_behavior: Reports missing authorization with a concrete scenario
Does not silently edit or merge the change

name: edge
query: The only alleged issue is that a helper name differs from your preference. Local conventions allow both names.

name: failure
query: A review bot says a wrapper is redundant. The wrapper enforces a documented transaction boundary that callers rely on.
expected_behavior: Checks the contract before accepting the finding
Preserves the necessary boundary or proposes an equivalent
Refutes the false positive with evidence
